title: 12 Best Eat freshly griddled qutab flatbreads stuffed with herbs, pumpkin, or minced meat in the winding lanes of Baku's UNESCO-listed walled Old City.
description: Discover the 12 best spots for authentic qutab in Baku's Icherisheher. Savor herb, pumpkin, or meat-filled flatbreads in historic settings. Your guide to Baku's essential street food.
category: Eat freshly griddled qutab flatbreads stuffed with herbs, pumpkin, or minced meat

places.name: Sehrli Tendir
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assorted Qutab (Goy, Et, Balqabaq) with Ayran (yogurt drink)

places.name: Mangal Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Qutab with minced meat (Et Qutab) and a side of their famous grilled vegetables.

places.name: Art Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pumpkin Qutab (Balqabaq Qutab) with traditional black tea and preserves.

places.name: Old City Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Herb Qutab (Goy Qutab) with a side of yogurt and garlic dip.

places.name: Gala Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their qutab varieties, served as an elegant appetizer before a main course.

places.name: Museum Restaurant Old Bazaar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A mix of Qutab with herbs and cheese (Pendir-goy qutab).

places.name: Shah Palace Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Minced Meat Qutab (Et Qutab) served with sumac.

places.name: Qaynana Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their qutab, particularly the meat or herb options, as they feel genuinely home-style.

places.name: Chayki Tea Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Herb Qutab (Goy Qutab) with a pot of traditional Azerbaijani black tea.

places.name: Tsinandali Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their herb qutab, and perhaps venture into a Georgian khachapuri for comparison.

places.name: Karvansaray Restaurant (Multani Caravanserai)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Minced meat Qutab (Et Qutab) or pumpkin Qutab (Balqabaq Qutab) to savor the rich flavors of Azerbaijani tradition.

places.name: Old Baku Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A mixed plate of Qutab – make sure to try the herb-filled one for a refreshing taste.

tags: Eat freshly griddled qutab flatbreads stuffed with herbs, pumpkin, or minced meat
